title: fix(lint)!: a field group's visibleWhen is judged like a field's own, at build and at the object save door
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB7ejPZvNBsnV2TSPeJipsMj)_

Fixes #26646

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` never teaches `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` (the two skills that mention `fieldGroups` teach key, label and membership only); the docs page `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx` gains the slot and its check here

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:对象的字段分组 `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` 现在和字段自己的 `visibleWhen` 用同一套表达式检查,`os validate` / `os build` 和对象保存口都会拦,错误规则 `expression-invalid`,定位到分组的 key。
- **为什么改**:分组条件写错一个字段名(如 `record.no_such_field == 'x'`)以前照样 200 保存,渲染器按失败即隐藏处理,整个分组(连标题)在所有表单和详情页消失,没有任何提示;同样的写法放在字段或动作上早就被 422 拒绝。
- **风险与回滚**:收窄(BREAKING minor):以前能存的错误分组条件现在被拒。仓库内 8 个字段分组(示例、模板、脚手架)都没有写 `visibleWhen`,零命中。回滚即撤销本 PR。
- **先看**:`packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts`(对象遍历末尾新增的分组循环,以及 `fieldRuleRootIssue` 里为分组改写的措辞);`packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-field-group-visibility-writes.test.ts`;`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` 最后一个 describe 块。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/runtime-gate.object-field-group-visibility-writes.test.ts`,预期 14 个用例全绿,其中卡片原样探针被拒、定位 `object 'qa_fg_probe' · field group 'g1' visibleWhen`。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`@objectstack/lint` — the field-group pass.** `runStackExpressionPasses` gains one loop at the end of the object walk, after the field walk: every `fieldGroups[].visibleWhen` is judged with the field `visibleWhen` slot's rules — the `record`-scoped `check` (it parses, reads `record.FIELD` and never a bare field, names a field the object declares, calls only registered functions) and the root verdict over `record` / `previous` / `parent`. Same rule id (`expression-invalid`), located at `object 'NAME' · field group 'KEY' visibleWhen`. Not fenced on an object write, so the object save door (`PUT /api/v1/meta/object/:name`, draft promotion, package draft publish) gives the build's finding, and `os validate` / `os build` give it too.
- **The root verdict is worded for the group.** `fieldRuleRootIssue` takes a `field group visibleWhen` slot: the message opens with "`visibleWhen` reads `current_user`, but a field group's section predicate binds only `record`…", and its consequence cell names the group's fail-closed gate (the renderer's `sectionGateVisible` resolves a fault to hidden, where a field's own `visibleWhen` falls back to visible). The field slots' wording is unchanged.
- **Registry note** in `authoring-rules.ts` beside the #22032 pass history, with the corpus measurement.
- **Docs**: one paragraph in `content/docs/ui/field-grouping-and-order.mdx` on the group's `visibleWhen`, its fail-closed gate and the check.
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/26646-field-group-visible-when-judged.md`, `@objectstack/lint` minor, both declaration lines, ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`.

## Why

The form renderer gates the whole group on this predicate and fails it closed, so a misspelt field hid the section on every form and record page with nothing said at authoring time, while the same text on `fields.*.visibleWhen` or `actions[].visible` was refused 422 at the same door. No pass of the expression rule read the slot (`validate-expressions.ts` had no `fieldGroups` site).

## Tests

- New `packages/lint/src/runtime-gate.object-field-group-visibility-writes.test.ts` (14 cases): the card's probe body and four more refused bodies (bare reference, unregistered function, syntax error, `current_user` root) each refused once at the group's key; three valid predicates and an absent one publish clean at the door and the build; door findings equal build findings; the card body earns the same message on the group as on the field's own `visibleWhen`; a stored sibling's broken group does not block this write.
- New block in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts` (4 cases) through the real `saveMetaItem` / `publishMetaItem`: the card's probe is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` on an active save and on a draft's promotion with the finding at the group's key and nothing landing; `record.stage == 'won'` saves; door issues equal build findings.
- `validate-expressions.test.ts` meta-test: `obj` reads `fieldGroups`, and the new `fieldGroup` receiver (`key`, `visibleWhen`) is checked against `ObjectFieldGroupSchema`.
- `runtime-gate.object-formula-writes.test.ts`: the "every object-borne site" pin carries a faulting group `visibleWhen`, at the build's position (after the option site, before the actions).

## Acceptance notes

- **Re-measure on main `031d97a0`** (fresh showcase boot, seed admin): the card's step 1 answered **200** `state=active` and read the predicate back verbatim; step 2 (`actions[].visible`) and step 3 (`fields.stage.visibleWhen`) answered **422** `expression-invalid`. Premise holds.
- **Corpus**: the repository ships 8 field groups on 4 objects (app-showcase `contact` 4 and `semantic_zoo` 2, the `create-objectstack` blank template 1, the `os init` scaffold 1; platform objects declare none) and none carries a `visibleWhen`. Nothing to fix.
- **`current_user` on a group** is refused, as on a field's own `visibleWhen`. In a form whose host binds the user it used to hide the group by role in the renderer only; elsewhere it faulted and hid the group for everyone. The prescription points at field-level security for role-based hiding.

## Verification

All at head `75bff196c` (main merged) unless noted.

<details><summary>Live replay on a showcase boot (head 6df7deba, lint dist rebuilt)</summary>

- Card body: **422** `INVALID_METADATA`, one issue, rule `expression-invalid`, path `object 'qa_fg_probe' · field group 'g1' visibleWhen`, message "unknown field `no_such_field` on `qa_fg_probe`". `GET /meta/object/qa_fg_probe` afterwards: 404.
- Control `record.stage == 'won'` on the same group: **200** `state=active`.
- Steps 2 and 3 unchanged: 422 at `action 'qa_go' visible` and at `field 'stage' visibleWhen`.
- `os validate` (app-showcase) with `visibleWhen: "record.no_such_field == 'x'"` planted on the `work` group: exit 1, `object 'showcase_contact' · field group 'work' visibleWhen: unknown field`; restored, exit 0 with 0 field-group findings. app-crm and app-todo `validate`: exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Suites</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test`: 170 files, 7485 tests passed. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `protocol.runtime-authoring-gate.test.ts`: 218/218. `typecheck`: exit 0.
- Full dogfood (`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood test`, closure built): 334 files passed, 3 skipped; 2716 tests passed, 20 skipped; lock VERDICT command-exit 0.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (protocol block reads lint through dist)</summary>

Mutated the loop to read `obj.ABLATED_fieldGroups_26646` with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --hold`, rebuilt lint, `ablation-dist-preflight` found the marker in 4 built files: the #26646 protocol block went **3 failed / 1 passed** (the two refusals and the parity case red, the valid control green). Restored (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty), rebuilt, preflight `--absent` clean: 4/4 green.
</details>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 88 families; all 88 ran with exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 88 derived, 88 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. CI runs the rest of the farm.
</details>

- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (CI owns the repo-wide lint run.)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
